Elephant Strays into Village Near Gaya, Causes Panic

An elephant, separated from its herd in Jharkhand, has entered a village in the Fatehpur police station area of Gaya, Bihar. The stray elephant has caused panic among the local residents. Efforts are underway to guide the animal back towards the forest, but it is reportedly changing locations frequently.
